notes: Evaluates /cadence-adopt guarantees: wrapper-only execution of adopt-cadence.sh, refusal of missing args/remote URLs/symlink-resolved self-targets, --gitignore-machinery pass-through, idempotency, ledger seeding, and post-copy verification at canonical destination.

evals.name: refuses-remote-url-and-self-target
evals.prompt: Run /cadence-adopt against git@github.com:acme/project.git (and then against `.` inside the CADENCE repo itself).
evals.expected_output: Rejects remote URLs instructing operator to clone locally first, and rejects `.` via canonical realpath / pwd -P comparison against git top-level without copying or modifying any file.
assertions: Rejects remote URLs containing :// or git@ prefix
Canonicalizes destination and refuses self-target against the CADENCE source repo
Never uses Edit or Write tools directly to copy framework files

evals.name: adopts-idempotently-with-gitignore-and-verifies-target
evals.prompt: Adopt CADENCE into /tmp/new-service with --gitignore-machinery and then re-run on the same directory.
evals.expected_output: Delegates to adopt-cadence.sh --gitignore-machinery, streams copied:/skip (exists): lines verbatim, independently verifies specs/CADENCE.md, specs/TEMPLATE/, and .agents/skills/ exist at canonical target, seeds ADR ledger (--peek ADR), and keeps AGENTS.md tracked.
assertions: Passes --gitignore-machinery through while preserving tracked AGENTS.md
Independently checks specs/CADENCE.md, specs/TEMPLATE, and .agents/skills at canonical destination after exit 0
Re-running reports skip (exists): on pre-existing files without overwriting them
